mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet (pet_id, member_id, name, species, breed, birth_date, gender, weight, neutered, reg_number, icon_type, medical_history, profile_img) VALUES (#{petId}, #{memberId}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{weight}, #{neutered}, #{regNumber}, #{iconType}, #{medicalHistory}, #{profileImg})
mapper.update: UPDATE pet SET name = #{name}, species = #{species}, breed = #{breed}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, weight = #{weight}, neutered = #{neutered}, reg_number = #{regNumber}, icon_type = #{iconType}, medical_history = #{medicalHistory}, profile_img = #{profileImg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId}
UPDATE pet SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId}
